Share sends an exported copy through the system share sheet. If recovery or a storage error appears, inspect the recovered copy and export it before replacing important files.
Choose Simulate to change input pins. A pin inside an instantiated child circuit is driven by its parent. Use Signals to inspect values; unknown and error bits are not zero.
Run advances clocks continuously. Pause stops automatic execution. Step advances one clock step; Event advances one pending propagation event.
Simulation options control frequency, propagation limit, startup memory and disconnected gate inputs. Clock component properties define high/low durations and phase.
Reset restarts simulation state. For an imported SAP-1, also pulse its Reset input from 0 to 1 and back to 0 before running. The program produces display 08 after 56 clock steps.
